entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold while I connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You're speaking with David at VeloFit. How can I help you today?
Hi, David. I... I need to see about a return. I just feel so bad about it. I've been a VeloFit customer for years and I've never returned anything before.
I understand, and we certainly appreciate your loyalty. I can definitely look into that for you. To get started, could you provide your name and the order number?
Yes, it's Sarah Miller. The order number is VF7781-B. It's for that new helmet I bought a couple of months ago.

Okay, Sarah, I have your account pulled up. I see the order for the Aero-Dynamic Helmet. To make sure I get you to the right place, is it a technical fault with the item, or more of a preference issue?

Oh, it's a preference thing, which is why I feel so silly. The color... it just doesn't look right with my bike. I thought it would be a perfect match, but it clashes terribly. The box is still unopened, I haven't even touched it. I just... I really needed that money back for some other things right now.
I see. Let me check the return policy for you. It looks like you received the item about 75 days ago. Just one moment.
Oh, has it been that long? I've just been so busy. I was really hoping you could help me out.
Absolutely, Sarah. I've just checked, and you are well within our 90-day return window for standard items. We can definitely process this return for a full refund for you. No problem at all.
Really? Oh, that is such a relief! I was so worried. Thank you so much, David!

Of course. When it comes to a helmet, we believe rider safety and confidence are paramount, and feeling good about your gear, including the color, is part of that. And since I see you're one of our VIP members, I've gone ahead and waived the return shipping fee for you. I'm emailing you a pre-paid return label right now.
Wow, you did that for me? That's amazing. VeloFit's customer service is just the best. You've really made my day.

It's my pleasure. You should see that email shortly. Just print the label, attach it to the shipping box, and drop it off at any postal service location. Once we receive the unopened box, your refund will be processed within 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can assist you with?
Nope, that's everything! Thank you again, David. You've been a huge help.
You're very welcome, Sarah. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
